theses.subject: Information Technology

evidence: Flow stage 'cooling' and negative flow_score for Information Technology sector

theses.subject: Industrials
theses.thesis: High rs_pctile (0.952) is heavily skewed by a single-name outlier (Honeywell +99.3% 20d); the sector move lacks broad participation and is likely to reverse.

theses.subject: Health Care
theses.thesis: Extreme rs_pctile (0.984) combined with very low cohesion (0.15) and leadership from outlier MRNA indicates a survivorship-biased, non-durable move susceptible to mean reversion.

theses.dissent: If MRNA’s performance is an early signal of a broader innovation wave in biotech/healthcare, the sector could continue to rally, invalidating the mean-reversion thesis.

falsifier.text: Equal-weighted Health Care sector 20d return exceeds +3% while MRNA contributes less than 25% of that gain.
